title: Amadeus Zero
summary: Steins;Gate 0 Amadeus AI companion with voice, 4-bucket memory & bilingual UI
description: Handheld port of kirina77/Amadeus-mobile for CardputerZero. Features a 320x170 Steins;Gate 0 call stage with blink and lip-sync, SQLite WAL+FTS5 4-bucket memory with 12h emotional continuity, single-key Alibaba Cloud DashScope (qwen-plus + qwen3-asr-flash + qwen3-tts-flash / qwen3-tts-vc voice cloning), DeepSeek SSE, Push-to-Talk STT, built-in Pinyin IME, LAN phone Web input, and instant zh/en UI switching (press L).

zh-CN.title: Amadeus Zero
zh-CN.summary: 命运石之门0 Amadeus 掌上AI伙伴（千问/DeepSeek语音对话 + 四桶记忆 + 中英双语）
zh-CN.description: 基于开源项目 kirina77/Amadeus-mobile 移植重构的 CardputerZero 掌上 AI 伙伴。支持 320×170 通话舞台、口型情绪差分、SQLite 四桶记忆与 12 小时情绪连续性、阿里云百炼单 Key（对话+识别+声音复刻）与 DeepSeek 流式对话、按住说话 PTT、离线拼音候选条、局域网手机辅助输入，按 L 键实时切换简体中文与 English 界面。
